subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should an ordinary assistant request timeout consume one same-model/profile retry before the established auth-profile rotation and model-fallback path?
rationale: This is not a mechanical correction to an established public contract: it intentionally trades faster failover for a bounded retry and affects auth-profile use, fallback timing, and operator-visible timeout behavior.

options.title: Approve the bounded retry policy
options.body: Accept one same-profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts after exact-head runtime and upgrade-safety proof confirms fallback and transcript behavior remain correct.

options.title: Keep immediate timeout escalation
options.body: Retain the current profile-rotation and fallback behavior for ordinary request timeouts and close this policy change as not accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded retry policy
recommendation.body: Accept one same-profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts after exact-head runtime and upgrade-safety proof confirms fallback and transcript behavior remain correct.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged idle-timeout escalation work is the closest feature-history precedent for the assistant failover decision being extended here.
